QUOTE: Without assembly it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a `volatile` global (`constant_time_impl.h:85-93`, `library/constant_time.c:29`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that without assembly `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` XORs with the volatile global `mbedtls_ct_zero`, which names the global. It doesn't say outright that the global holds zero, but the name `mbedtls_ct_zero` implies it.
